questions.title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
questions.background: A parliamentary resignation can trigger a by-election, which the departing MP may contest to seek a fresh mandate.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place. Accepted Answer Format : The party leader's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Rupert Lowe (Restore Britain leader, MP for Great Yarmouth) uniquely fits both historical UK precedents for an MP resigning to contest a by-election: he was elected under Reform UK in 2024 before launching Restore Britain in Feb 2026 (which just finished 3rd in Makerfield with ~7%), and on May 15, 2026 he lost his High Court challenge to halt a parliamentary ICGS watchdog probe, creating strong incentive to seek a fresh mandate or preempt a suspension/recall petition. Very few UK party leaders sit in the Commons; Nigel Farage (Reform UK), Jeremy Corbyn (Your Party, elected Independent), Zarah Sultana (ex-Labour/Your Party), and Kemi Badenoch represent smaller tails, with ~12% left for other minor-party MP leaders (e.g., Northern Ireland party leaders or a newly formed breakaway party).

questions.title: What principal criminal penalty will Hannah Dugan receive at her initial sentencing for obstructing a federal proceeding?
questions.background: A federal jury convicted Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan of obstructing a federal proceeding in December 2025. The case concerned her response to immigration agents seeking to arrest a defendant at her courthouse.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The federal court’s sentencing judgment or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the sentence announced in court. Resolution Conditions : Resolve when the federal district court first imposes a sentence for Dugan’s obstruction conviction. Identify the principal criminal penalty imposed at that sentencing. Subsequent appeals or resentencing do not change the answer. Accepted Answer Format : A short noun phrase naming the principal criminal penalty.
questions.current_reasoning: Former Milwaukee County Judge Hannah Dugan (67, no criminal record, resigned Jan. 3) is scheduled for sentencing on July 8, 2026 before U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman after he denied her post-trial motion on June 16. AP and Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reporting consistently emphasize that federal guidelines generally call for probation for nonviolent first-time offenders and that Judge Adelman is nationally known for below-guidelines, non-custodial sentences. A prison sentence remains a meaningful secondary risk (~18%) given DOJ pressure, abuse-of-judicial-trust aggravators, and expected lack of contrition ahead of her Seventh Circuit appeal, alongside smaller chances for home confinement, a standalone fine, or time served.

questions.title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
questions.background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify. Resolution Date : The date parliament elects the successor. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the person elected.
questions.current_reasoning: Moldova's pro-EU ruling party PAS holds a 55/101 parliamentary majority alongside President Maia Sandu, so the successor to PM Alexandru Munteanu (whose Control Corps resigned over loss of trust on June 24, 2026) will be a PAS-backed pick. Top internal cabinet/party contenders are Deputy PM & Foreign Minister Mihai Popșoi, Deputy PM for European Integration Cristina Gherasimov (aligned with the EU accession priority), PAS leader and Speaker Igor Grosu, Deputy PM Vladimir Bolea, and Deputy PM for Economic Development Eugen Osmochescu. Because Sandu and PAS have a strong base rate of tapping surprise technocrats or presidential advisers (as with Dorin Recean in 2023 and Munteanu in Nov 2025), 42% probability mass is left outside the top five.

questions.title: Who will succeed Brendon McCullum as permanent head coach of England's men's Test team?
questions.background: Brendon McCullum currently coaches England's men's Test cricket team.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official England and Wales Cricket Board appointment announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement. Resolution : Resolve to the first person formally appointed as McCullum's permanent successor as head coach of England's men's Test team. Interim appointments and appointments solely concerning limited-overs cricket do not count. Resolution occurs when the appointment is announced, even if the coach begins work later. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed coach's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Although the ECB backed Brendon McCullum in March 2026 after the 4-1 Ashes defeat, England have lost six of their last eight Tests and face intense scrutiny after the Stokes/Atkinson curfew breach and 253-run Oval loss to New Zealand ahead of the June 25 decider. If the ECB replaces McCullum or splits Test/white-ball roles before the August Pakistan series, recently available ex-Afghanistan coach Jonathan Trott (52 Tests for England, publicly eager for the role) and ECB-contracted England Lions coach Andrew Flintoff (backed by Rob Key) are the two most prominently linked candidates. Former Ashes-winning coach Andy Flower, internal England batting assistant Marcus Trescothick, and Rajasthan Royals director Kumar Sangakkara round out the top five, with substantial 45% field uncertainty covering Gary Kirsten, Ravi Shastri, Justin Langer, Alec Stewart, and surprise ECB hires.

local_articles.title: Brendon McCullum tried his best to ‘talk Ben Stokes out' of retirement, but England captain said, ‘I'm done'
local_articles.snippet: England coach Brendon McCullum on Monday revealed that he tried his best to talk Ben Stokes out of retirement, but the Test captain had already made up his mind and wasn't willing to change his decision. The premier all-rounder announced his international retirement on Sunday, midway through Day 4 of the Trent Bridge Test against New Zealand. Hours after making the decision public, Stokes came out to open the batting in his final innings, scoring 30 runs off 20 balls. However, Stokes' international career came to a sad end on Monday as England went down to New Zealand in the series decider, losing the three-match series 2-1. The 35-year-old had missed the second Test after he was dropped from the squad. Stokes was left out after he broke the team curfew and went to the nightclub with pacer Gus Atkinson. questions.title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
questions.background: This question concerns completed transfers into Premier League clubs ahead of the 2026–27 season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve using Al Jazeera Sport's reporting of completed transfers after England's 2026 summer transfer window closes. The answer is the player whose transfer fee, expressed in pounds sterling, is the highest paid by a Premier League club during that window. Exclude proposed or failed transfers. Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major June 25-26 breakthrough (BBC Sport/Sami Mokbel, The Athletic/David Ornstein, Fabrizio Romano, Reuters, Press Association): Manchester City have reached a full club-to-club agreement with Nottingham Forest to sign England midfielder Elliot Anderson, with a US medical scheduled this weekend and personal terms not expected to be an issue. City sources put the fee at a club-record £116m guaranteed (tying Florian Wirtz as joint-2nd highest Premier League transfer ever), while Forest/PA/Telegraph/BBC report a potential British-record £130m total package eclipsing Alexander Isak's £125m move. Only one transfer in Premier League history has ever exceeded £116m. With ~93% deal-completion probability (small medical/World Cup injury snag risk before signing) and ~78-80% probability that no other Premier League club tops £116m-£130m over the remaining 67 days—especially with City's budget now spent, Liverpool's €100m (~£85m) Yan Diomande bid rejected by Leipzig (targeting Diomande + Barcola for ~£200m combined), Villa telling Arsenal Morgan Rogers is not for sale, and Julian Alvarez pushing for Barcelona—Elliot Anderson surges from 0.14 to 0.73, leaving 27% across Diomande (0.06), Rogers (0.04), Barcola (0.035), Bruno Guimaraes (0.02), and the wide field (0.115).

questions.background: Rodri is a midfielder for Manchester City.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the receiving club in Rodri's first completed permanent transfer from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window. Transfer rumours, bids, and agreements in principle do not qualify. Resolution Date : The date the completed transfer is officially announced. Accepted Answer Format : The receiving club's commonly used name.
questions.current_reasoning: Rodri (30) has one year left on his Manchester City contract following Pep Guardiola's exit and confirmed to BBC Sport (June 1) he will resolve his future after the World Cup. Conditional on a permanent summer 2026 transfer occurring, Real Madrid are the dominant destination across BBC, Marca, TEAMtalk, and Football Insider, with returning boss Jose Mourinho and Florentino Perez prioritizing the Madrid-born midfielder. PSG (linked June 13 under his former Spain boss Luis Enrique), former club Atletico Madrid, Barcelona, and Bayern Munich represent the main alternative elite landing spots.

local_articles.title: Manchester City hire Enzo Maresca to start new era after Pep Guardiola’s departure
local_articles.snippet: – Manchester City have hired former Chelsea boss Enzo Maresca to lead the club into a new era after Pep Guardiola stepped down at the end of last season. The former Premier League champions made the announcement on June 29, with Maresca agreeing a three-year contract with City after being forced to wait several weeks to seal his move to the Etihad Stadium. “Manchester City is a club I know very well and to have the chance to manage this team is a brilliant opportunity for me,” said the Italian, who also coached Leicester in the Championship. “City is an incredibly well-run football club. Everything they do is innovative, planned and purposeful. For a manager, that is a dream situation. It provides the consistency I need to do my job effectively.” The 46-year-old had been strongly linked with the City job once reports emerged of Guardiola’s potential exit. local_articles.snippet: Enzo Maresca has been confirmed as Manchester City’s new manager on a three-year contract, the Italian returning to the club where he worked as an assistant to Pep Guardiola for 12 months. City have paid Chelsea £17m (€20m) in compensation for their former head coach and Maresca also agreed a personal settlement with the west London club and apologised for the impact of his departure at the start of the year. Maresca has been expected to take over from Guardiola ever since the Spaniard confirmed he would be leaving City but lengthy negotiations were held over recompense Chelsea felt they were due. Chelsea say Maresca notified them of the potential opportunity to replace Guardiola at the end of last season and it was clear he wanted to pursue this, with the club claiming his resignation at the turn of the year “was a major contributing factor” to their poor campaign. questions.title: Who will win the Most Valuable Player award at the 2026 MLB All-Star Game?
questions.background: The MLB All-Star Game is an annual exhibition between the American League and National League. Its Most Valuable Player award recognizes an individual player's performance in the game.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : MLB's official announcement of the 2026 All-Star Game MVP, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable news reporting. Resolution Timing : The question resolves when the MVP recipient is publicly announced following the 2026 All-Star Game, expected in July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the player awarded the game's MVP honor.
questions.current_reasoning: The 2026 MLB All-Star Game is July 14 at hitter-friendly Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, and as a single-game exhibition featuring ~60 players, even the top MVP favorites carry only 4%-7% true probability (leaving ~73% on the rest of the field). As of the June 22 Phase 1 voting update, Shohei Ohtani leads all of MLB (2.31M votes) as a locked-in NL DH starter with strong voter bias, while Yordan Alvarez (1.97M votes, 25 HRs, 191 OPS+) and Bobby Witt Jr. (1.70M votes) are runaway AL starting locks. MLB home run leader Kyle Schwarber (29 HRs, Phillies hometown crowd favorite despite minor June 23 back tightness and likely reserve role behind Ohtani) and resurgent two-time ASG MVP Mike Trout (1.74M votes, Philadelphia-area native) round out the top five ahead of Aaron Judge, who has been dealing with a June injury.

local_articles.title: 3 Phillies are finalists to start 2026 MLB All-Star Game as Phase 2 of fan voting opens
local_articles.snippet: Phillies fans who want to see the members of the group formerly known as "The Daycare" start the MLB All-Star Game in two weeks at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia can do their part now. MLB opened Phase 2 of its All-Star Game voting at noon Monday, allowing fans to vote for the starters in each league. Phase 2 ends at noon Thursday. The Phillies have three finalists for a starting job on the National League team: Alec Bohm, Brandon Marsh and Bryson Stott. Marsh secured the second-most votes of any NL outfielder during Phase 1 amid a breakout season. The 28-year-old enters the Phillies' series with the Pirates on Monday, hitting .321/.353/.510 with 12 home runs and an .863 OPS. It would be his first All-Star appearance.
